ask: mkae a runing tab for the trip so we can see who owse who plz
sentence: A shared running tab where each person logs what they paid, costs are split evenly among everyone in the chat, and it shows who should pay whom to settle up.
use_when: a group trip has shared costs and people want to see who owes who
friends take turns paying for food, gas, or lodging and want an even split
someone wants to log an expense and mark a debt as paid later
dont_use_when: costs need to be split unevenly or by item
the group wants a one-off vote or poll on where to go
a planned schedule or packing list is needed rather than money tracking
